---
name: "nf-core/fastq_ngscheckmate"
description: "Take a set of fastq files and run NGSCheckMate to determine whether\
  \ samples match with each other, using a set of SNPs."
keywords:
- "ngscheckmate"
- "qc"
- "fastq"
- "snp"
components:
- "ngscheckmate/fastq"
- "ngscheckmate/vafncm"
input:
- ch_fastq:
    type: "file"
    description: "Channel containing single or paired fastq files.\n\nStructure: [\
      \ val(meta), [ path(fastq) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*.fastq.gz"
- ch_snp_pt:
    type: "file"
    description: "Channel containing the binary PT file with the SNPs to analyse.\
      \ NGSCheckMate\nprovides one for human samples. Only the first element is used,\
      \ so the meta\nmap identifies the SNP set, e.g. `[ id:'sarscov2' ]`.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta2), path(snp_pt) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.pt"
output:
- corr_matrix:
    type: "file"
    description: "A text file containing the correlation matrix between each sample.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta2), path(corr_matrix) ]\n"
    pattern: "*corr_matrix.txt"
- matched:
    type: "file"
    description: "A txt file containing only the samples that match with each other.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta2), path(matched) ]\n"
    pattern: "*matched.txt"
- all:
    type: "file"
    description: "A txt file containing all the sample comparisons, whether they match\
      \ or not.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta2), path(all) ]\n"
    pattern: "*all.txt"
- vaf:
    type: "file"
    description: "Per-sample text file containing the reference/alt allele depth for\
      \ each SNP.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(vaf) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.vaf"
- pdf:
    type: "file"
    description: "An optional pdf containing a dendrogram showing how the samples\
      \ match up.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta2), path(pdf) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.pdf"
authors:
- "@SPPearce"
maintainers:
- "@SPPearce"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/ngscheckmate/fastq@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/ngscheckmate/vafncm@0.0.0-6d1763b"
